implementation_notes: Scoring thresholds are reproduced from the NIA protocol and applied after rounding to two decimals where thresholds are expressed to hundredths.
The Arabic page paraphrases operational instructions rather than presenting itself as a validated Arabic translation study.
Domain scores are retained separately from the total because identical totals can reflect different performance profiles.
